# Medical Wholesale Outlet

> > Medical Wholesale Outlet is a wholesale distributor of medical supplies specializing in diabetes testing equipment, glucose monitoring systems, infection control products, and clinical diagnostic supplies.

The site offers comprehensive diabetes management solutions including glucose meters from brands like Clever Choice Pro, Prodigy Autocode, Accu-Chek, and Contour, along with test strips, lancets, and CGM systems like Dexcom G6. They also provide infection control products (CaviWipes), sharps disposal containers, urinalysis supplies, and other medical consumables for healthcare facilities and individuals.

## Key Topics

- Diabetes testing and monitoring
- Blood glucose meters and test strips
- Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)
- Dexcom G6 sensors
- Clever Choice Pro and Prodigy meters
- Accu-Chek and Contour systems
- Lancets and sharps disposal
- Infection control and surface disinfection
- CaviWipes disinfectant
- Urinalysis reagent strips
- Medicare-covered medical supplies
- CLIA-waived diagnostic tests
- Medical consumables and disposables
- Healthcare facility supplies
- Wholesale medical distribution
